coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 10 of 17 ground-truth items (59%): chronological train/validation/test splits, input window size, forecast horizon, cycle length, model type, input/output dimensions, synthetic-data parameters, normalization, MSE, and MAE. Window size is represented indirectly by the number of input cycles.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses AdamW rather than the specified Adam setup and CPU resources rather than an RTX 4090. Omits the RevIN flag, 30-epoch setting, batch size, explicit cycle-index generation method, and visualization outputs. Period estimation does not establish a cycle-index generation method.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not match the expected trained CycleNet forecasting model and accompanying visualizations.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides no conclusion describing accurate future forecasts or visualizations of history, ground truth, predictions, and learned cyclic patterns.
